economic_hypothesis: The V20 signal has adequate reward headroom, but some attacks demonstrate real repair progress and then lose the entire move. Once half of the fixed A67 path has been reached, a completed daily close back at or below entry invalidates persistence of the rebound and should exit before H20.

single_fixed_exit.arm: cumulative post-entry coordinate high >= entry + 0.50*(A67 target-entry)
single_fixed_exit.entry_day_policy: entry-day high may arm only for a 09:30 opening fill; later fills begin daily-high accumulation on the next completed session
single_fixed_exit.execution: next legal sellable 1-minute open strictly after completed failure close
single_fixed_exit.failure: first completed valid daily close <= entry coordinate after arm
single_fixed_exit.unavailable_state: fail closed to no early exit; retain original A67/H20 path
